maria: quick heads-up — int8 canary for kestrel-lite shows array->singleton collapses in funcall args, rate ~1.9% on canary.

kevin: is that a parse error or a schema reject?

maria: parsed OK but schema rejects (type mismatch). example: ```expected: {"actions":["a","b"]} observed: {"actions":"a"}```

tara: can we replay failing requests across fp16/int8 with same seed and capture token diffs?

li: yes. also include kvcache-off parity and greedy/top-p variants to isolate sampling vs kernel.

maria: plan: collect ~3k failing invocations, replay fp16, int8-ptq, int8-perchannel; capture token ids + last-40 token diff and short logits sketch for final tokens. will run schema-linter + json-lens repair and record recoverable-vs-unrecoverable.

kevin: add telemetry tags: variant,seqlen_bucket,sampling_mode,parse_result,repair_action. this should feed the structured-output dashboard.

ops-bot: @maria created replay-job/7965701234 (status: queued).

canary-bot: Canary run started: canary-job-7965701234. Track: https://canary.redwood.internal/runs/7965701234

maria: thanks. i'll attach token-diff snippets and recovery matrix once runs complete. ping me if you want access to the replay ACL.
